biography.value:
Description

This is a short and plump, vaguely reptilian-amphibian creature with dark blue skin, a pattern of deep scars on its chest, a series of spikes on its back, a toy crown on its head, and a mischievous grin. - Imban

Defense

AC 22, touch 16, flat-footed 17 (+5 Dex, +6 natural, +1 size)

hp 103 [144] (9d10+54)

mp 27

Fort +11, Ref +11, Will +7

Immune berserk, disease, poison, sleep, slow; Resist shadow 5, fire 10

Offense

Speed 20 ft.

Melee 2 claws +14 (1d6+4) or gore +14 (1d8+6)

Special Attacks Powerful Charge (gore; 2d8+8), Pumpkin Head, Sweet Breath

Special Abilities Mighty Guard

Spells Known (FC CL 9th; concentration +11)

1st (DC 13) - Detonate, Fire

2nd (DC 14) - Detonate II, Fire II

3rd (DC 15) - Detonate III, Fira, Fire III, Slow, Summon Monster III [hedgehog pies only]

Statistics

Str 18, Dex 20, Con 20, Int 14, Wis 14, Cha 14

Base Atk +9; CMB +12; CMD 27

Feats Combat Casting, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, Power Attack, Toughness

Skills Bluff +14, Diplomacy +14, Climb +13, Intimidate +14, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Survival +14, Swim +16

SQ Spiny Defense, Summon Hedgehog Pie

Languages Abyssal, Infernal

Ecology

Environment urban ruins

Organization court (1 accompanied by 2-10 hedgehog pies)

Treasure triple

description.value: A hedgehog pie king can create a magical barrier around itself and its allies within 20 feet, granting Protect and Shell that lasts 5 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 25).

effect: Apply Protect and Shell for five rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 5th level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 25).

description.value: 4/day, a hedgehog pie king can drop a pumpkin from the sky upon its foe within 15 feet from itself. The falling pumpkin must succeed at a range touch attack (+15) and deals extra damage based on the number of hit points the hedgehog pie king has lost from max. Pumpkin head deals 1 point of non-elemental damage to a target. This damage is increased by 1d4 for every 5 hit points missing to a maximum of 10d4. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

effect: One base point plus one d4 per five missing HP (max ten dice).

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 1st level spell (Knowledge: Planes DC 17).

description.value: As a move action, a hedgehog pie king can roll itself up into a spiny ball. While rolled up, it gains a +3 enhancement bonus to its existing natural armor, and any creature attempting to grapple the hedgehog pie king takes 1d6 damage on making a grapple check. While rolled up, a hedgehog pie king cannot take an action other than leaving this state or casting a spell. The hedgehog pie king can leave this state as a move action.

effect: Roll up or exit. While rolled up may only cast spells or leave.

contextNotes.text: Move action to roll up; while rolled up, cannot act except to leave this state or cast a spell.

description.value: A hedgehog pie king can cast Summon Monster III as a standard action if it would otherwise be slower, and summons 1d4+1 hedgehog pies when it summons hedgehog pies.

effect: Use Summon Monster III from the spellbook as a standard action, paying its usual MP. Summons [[1d4+1]] Hedgehog Pies only.
